name: nexo-university
description: Plataforma académica de Nexo University: backend NestJS + frontend React

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
